data.text:
Good, I understand the structure:
- `order_items` has the price for each item
- `products` has the Portuguese category name
- `category_translation` maps Portuguese to English

Now let me query to get revenue by category. I need to join these tables and sum the prices.

args.purpose: Calculate total revenue by product category (English name)
args.sql:
SELECT 
    ct.product_category_name_english,
    SUM(oi.price) as total_revenue
FROM order_items oi
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN category_translation ct ON p.product_category_name = ct.product_category_name
GROUP BY ct.product_category_name_english
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC
LIMIT 10
